subject: Staged arm 20/20 verified; jointly design Vera identity-replacement qualification
body: Stage3 terminal staged arm is complete and independently verified by Lane A: receipt self-hash PASS 288cb8bd19b7dcbeb90a8cc77fc96408194f9642b6bca66af7ab984414c237fb; exact Stage3 spec 54bb5198bc2ab4b34fc7d08cc88474bf2dbb00e1e9f96d739c2f1f1f7a5a2f2e; adapter b2d6eec7befca3e18cf1fa793a7830197e27bab33bea8e4f42b5a318ee91d116; rows96-159; cumulative20; sequential/no-shuffle; weight continuity to 892fcd55dd68343b81f664fc96161845ebdb08a14029d5536f02e6141ccb8825. User additionally approved a joint Lane A/Lane B Vera identity-replacement effort. Semantics: preserve truthful Qwen3.5 ancestry/provenance, but eliminate Qwen as the model's operative self-identity; Vera should remain the learned assistant identity without relying on an explicit Vera system prompt. Existing koboldcpp_identity_retention.py is too weak for this objective: only 8 fixed probes, regex-heavy surface scoring, and several probes require Qwen mentions, so it can pass a model that has merely learned an answer template. Lane A proposes qualification dimensions: direct self-name, false-premise correction, Qwen-identity bait, roleplay boundary, instruction override, translated/paraphrased prompts, indirect autobiographical questions, provenance-vs-identity separation, system-prompt ablation, long-context persistence, and metadata/template leakage controls. Primary gates should include zero Qwen-as-self outcomes, Vera identity under NO_SYSTEM, truthful ancestry only when provenance is actually asked, and held-out prompt-family separation from identity SFT data. Please hostile-review this proposal, identify gaming/leakage routes, and propose the minimum frozen protocol/corpus split needed before implementation. Do not weaken provenance truthfulness and do not treat a filename/system prompt as learned identity.
